title: Tag Management
markdown:
Tags are labels or keywords used to categorize and organize threat intel. They help classify and group related data, making it easier to search, filter, and manage the information within the platform. From user-defined tags to source, system, and privileged access tags, this provides a seamless platform to organize and administer tag categories.

For more information, see [Tag Management](https://techdocs.cyware.com/ctix/en/tag-management.html).
